before_times: consult, follow-up, PRP or a transplant day
which visit: the clinic's own visit types only, never a scalp symptom or a photo typed into the AI
paying yourself, or a health plan (its name only)
for a video visit: the state the patient will be in
join the list for a sooner time
after_time: anything the clinic should know to help, like a wheelchair or needing an interpreter
for a home visit: the room the visit will be in, and whether an adult is there
secure_page_only: health history: medicines, blood thinners, allergies, scalp conditions, past treatments
photos of the scalp, if the patient wants the physician to see them first (optional; never by text or through the AI)
a written quote OK'd, and the consent forms for a procedure
a parent's or guardian's consent for anyone under 18 (where the clinic books minors at all)

intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, scalp details, photos and results are never asked or typed in the AI chat or a text
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a transplant day needs an adult ride home; the clinic books no one under 18 for a procedure

stop.words: swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, or trouble breathing (for example after a new medicine or a numbing shot)
stop.say: This needs care now. Call 911. Don't wait for a clinic visit.

stop.words: bleeding that won't stop after 20 minutes of firm pressure
stop.say: Call 911 or go to the emergency room now.

stop.words: a fast-spreading red scalp with pus or a fever after a procedure
stop.say: Please call 911 or go to the emergency room now.

stop.words: a swallowed medicine, or too much of one
stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222, or 911 if they're not awake or not breathing.

go_on.words: a scalp area that's red, hot and spreading, or a sore after an injection
go_on.what: the safety steps first: go to urgent care today, or call the clinic's own line; the booking can go on after

go_on.words: thinning, shedding or a question about results, with nothing else
go_on.what: matched to the clinic's own visit types; Rosie never says what a scalp change might be or how soon to be seen

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Consent and health history
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; for a transplant day, signed before the quote is final
steps.result: not done by its due date: the clinic keeps the visit only once it's signed on the secure page, or moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand; when the desk is closed, by the next business day
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written quote for a transplant day and self-pay work
steps.when: before any deposit: sent within 1 business day (the example clinic's rule)
steps.who: every patient paying for themselves, and every transplant day
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date; no deposit is taken until the patient says yes to the quote

steps.name: A consult before a transplant day
steps.when: at least 2 weeks before the day
steps.result: the physician OKs the day, suggests another plan, or calls it off; the owner decides any refund

first_steps_and_forms.prep: new patients arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID and the plan card; for a transplant day, bring the adult who drives home; the clinic's own notes for the visit are on the secure page

staff.skills: Sofia (physician): consults, transplant days, PRP; Noah (physician assistant): follow-ups, PRP where the state allows; Ivy (nurse practitioner) and Leo (registered nurse): scalp care visits at home under Sofia's orders; the clinic's technicians: graft work only under the physician's direct supervision, never a consult or a price; the front desk: no clinical OKs
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each physician's and physician assistant's own license, per state; the owner's word, never looked up by Rosie
staff.supervision: a physician assistant or nurse works under the physician's orders or supervision as each state sets; the supervisor must be working or reachable, as the state sets
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs fees, quotes and transplant days; every price is on the list or in a written quote
staff.stand_in: no stand-in for a transplant day or a consult with Sofia; a physician assistant may do a follow-up when Sofia is out, only with the patient's yes; with no yes, nobody is moved: the time stays, and the desk calls

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a transplant day needs an adult ride home; the clinic books no one under 18 for a procedure
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

visit.check_in: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk; by video: the code read out at the start; at a home visit: the code at the door of the room the visit is in
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the clinician's notes and photos taken at the visit stay in the clinic's own medical record, never in a text
visit.changes_at_visit: a second session, or an added service, is only with the patient's yes after the physician explains it; its price comes from the written quote; no deposit is taken for it at the visit
visit.before_work: the physician or physician assistant reads the health history and any photos the patient added, and checks for changes

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: the owner's word: each physician and physician assistant holds their own license, and the clinic its registration, where the state's form asks; Rosie never looks a license up
license.who: each person; the clinic too, where the state's form asks
license.ask: each physician's license number in their invite reply, or from the owner; the clinic's registration from the owner (optional)
license.insurance: malpractice insurance: the owner's word, never checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the procedure, the plan, the reason, a scalp detail, photos or results; flow A's texts drop the physician's name; at a home visit the clinician's name stays, for the door check
